# Satwik Farms

> Satwik Farms is a farm-to-home delivery service and residue-free farm based in Kisarawe, Tanzania. We offer door-to-door delivery of groceries and daily essentials — fresh vegetables, fruits, dairy, dry goods, pulses, grains, spices, cooking oils, personal care, and household essentials — to homes and businesses in Dar es Salaam. We deliver everything except meat, alcohol, and tobacco. Our own farm in Kisarawe grows residue-free vegetables and dairy without chemical pesticides or synthetic fertilisers. We also offer weekend farm visits, educational tours, and farm experiences near Dar es Salaam.

## What We Do

Satwik Farms is a comprehensive home delivery and farm service operating across five areas:

1. **Grocery & Daily Essentials Delivery** — Door-to-door delivery of groceries, fresh produce, fruits, vegetables, dairy, and daily food essentials to homes and offices in Dar es Salaam. One call or app order away.
2. **Fresh Residue-Free Vegetables** — Vegetables grown on our own farm in Kisarawe without chemical pesticides or synthetic fertilisers. Harvest-to-door often within the same day.
3. **Fresh Fruits** — Fresh seasonal fruits delivered to your door in Dar es Salaam.
4. **Dairy Products** — Fresh milk, yoghurt, and ghee from our ethically raised cattle. No hormones, no antibiotics, no artificial additives. Delivered to Dar es Salaam.
5. **Farm Visits & Tours** — Weekend farm tours in Kisarawe for families, school groups, and corporates. Activities include guided field walks, nature trails, mud baths, tree planting, cattle interaction, and fresh farm-to-table vegetarian meals. Adults: TZS 50,000. Children: TZS 30,000.
6. **Health & Wellness Products** — Multigrain diabetic flour (millet-based, wheat-free), roasted seed mixes, dried jamun pulp, jamun seed powder (Jamun Beej Churna), natural soaps, multani mitti (fuller's earth), and natural honey. Available for delivery.

## Location & Delivery

- **Farm location:** Kisarawe, Pwani Region, Tanzania (45km from Dar es Salaam)
- **Delivery area:** Dar es Salaam (homes, offices, and businesses across the city)
- **Farm visits:** Weekends only, by booking
- **Contact:** WhatsApp +255 767 211 422
- **App:** Available on Android (Google Play) and iOS (App Store) — search "Satwik Farms"

## Products & Delivery Catalogue

### Fresh Vegetables (Residue-Free, Seasonal)
Spinach, kale, amaranth (mchicha), tomatoes, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, courgettes, capsicum (bell peppers), leafy greens, herbs (coriander, basil, mint), and other seasonal produce. All grown on our own farm in Kisarawe without chemical residues.

### Fresh Fruits
Seasonal fresh fruits delivered to your door in Dar es Salaam. Contact us via WhatsApp or app to see current availability.

### Groceries & Daily Essentials
Door-to-door delivery of groceries and daily essentials in Dar es Salaam — including dry goods, pulses, grains, cooking oils, spices, personal care items, and household essentials. We deliver everything except meat, alcohol, and tobacco. Order via our app (Android/iOS) or WhatsApp at +255 767 211 422.

### Dairy Products
- **Fresh milk** — Collected daily, delivered same day or next day
- **Yoghurt** — Live culture, no thickeners or preservatives
- **Ghee** — Pure clarified butter, slow-cooked, no additives

### Health & Wellness Products
- **Millet Master Diabetic Atta** — 100% wheat-free multigrain flour; jowar, bajra, soy, chickpea, ragi; GI ~48; suited for diabetics and low-GI diets
- **Roasted Seed Mix** — Flax, chia, pumpkin, sunflower, sesame, watermelon seeds; GI 15–25; ideal Omega-3:6 ratio of ~2.3:1
- **Dried Jamun Pulp** — Ayurvedic blood sugar support; contains jamboline and jambosine
- **Jamun Beej Churna (Jamun Seed Powder)** — Concentrated Ayurvedic remedy for blood sugar, digestion, and detox
- **Natural soaps** — Handmade
- **Multani Mitti** — Fuller's earth face mask
- **Natural honey**
